surveyedOfficeSourceReceipts.hold: Two of the five accounts did not establish personal experience as a client, family member or person arranging care.
Four displayed comments concern vehicles or medical transportation rather than in-home care.
Visible comments include a professional employment perspective and medical care across settings.
Trainee reviews are present alongside home-care client accounts.
Only one of three rated experiences was visible and its service setting was unspecified.
Two visible records repeat the same generic praise, and other comments do not clearly establish receiving home care.
The visible sample includes clinical-only and referral-professional accounts.
One visible comment does not establish who used the service.
The source includes medical-only treatment and a dual-role professional and family member. Family comments retained where they described hiring and receiving care.
The full page confirms the exact office and includes two identifiable family accounts, but the remaining commenters give too little information to establish the rating population.
Other reviewers give insufficient information about their relationship to the agency. One customer also described possible employment overlap.
